context_requirements: Topical sunscreens are designed for inert UV absorption/reflection in skin; they lack a defined intracellular protein target in the Drug Repurposing Hub
No UV radiation is applied in this experiment, so the photoprotective mechanism cannot be engaged
Responsive lines would need to express a specific sunscreen-binding target, which is not established for these nine cancer lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches a known target pathway (e.g., AhR, ER, or oxidative-stress response)
Evidence of cytotoxicity or stress-response induction (HSPA1A, DNAJB1, ATF6, DDIT3-like programs) at 10 micromolar
